serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-prompt-leak-scanner
serverInfo.description: MCP server and reverse proxy that catches leaked credentials and PII (API keys, TC Kimlik No, credit cards, IBANs) in outbound LLM prompts before they leave your application

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan a raw text string for leaked credentials and PII, checksum-validated where applicable to keep false positives low.

tools.name: scan_messages
tools.description: Scan an OpenAI/Anthropic-style chat request body for leaked credentials and PII in every message's text content.

body.description: The chat request body object, e.g. { model, system, messages: [{ role, content }] }

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single file — plain text, or a JSON chat-request-body fixture (auto-detected) — for leaked credentials and PII

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to scan

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Recursively scan a directory of prompt logs or request-body fixtures for leaked credentials and PII

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 5000)

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List every credential/PII pattern this scanner detects, grouped by category
